source: W20 Changing Breeds (Onyx Path, 2013): the Gifts of each Fera breed, with the printed page. Gifts the book sends to the Garou list are on the W20 list.

gifts.e: Doubles the damage of a surprise attack before soak.
No limit on blood spent each turn.
Never looks dishevelled: no Appearance penalties for dirt or disarray.
Holds breath for Obedience minutes, longer with successes.
A drinker of the blood who fails Willpower sees violent hallucinations.
Can eat and digest anything, fetishes included, and bite through armour.
Huge form Str+5 Sta+6 Per+2; Delirium.
Blood pool grows to 15, 20 or 25 at Rank 3, 4 or 5.

gifts.n: Paws of the Raging Spirit Tiger

spec.name: Paws of the Raging Spirit Tiger

gifts.e: Decoy ravens until sunrise; foes must pick out the real one.
While the performance lasts, watchers with Willpower at or below the successes stand dazed; violence breaks it.
Ten pounds of matter turn to dust per success; living or undead flesh at difficulty 8.
A killing frenzy in war form for permanent-Rage turns, then all Rage is gone and four hours of sleep follow.
Conjures a little food or coin.
No Curse: the Rage does not unsettle people.
Unhindered travel for the scene, one more companion per extra success.
The land within Honor x 20 yards goes back to the wild.
A Medicine diagnosis in one turn.
A touch: the target ignores wound penalties for the fight.
Any look in the Umbra for Wisdom days.
An illusion that fools the senses; the supernatural resist only with cause.
Knows the Realm, the directions and the way home.

gifts.n: By the Light of the Moon

gifts.e: A talisman draws creatures, more with successes.
Successes = people who use the group's best rating in one Ability.
Grows a feature per success (only legs work fully).
Travels the waters of the Umbra.
Body heat lowered for hours: unseen by heat senses.
+3 diff to pick the user out of a group.
Looks like another kind of shifter, with none of its powers.
Lays a false trail for Humor days.
Eating a supernatural's heart or brain gives three of its powers at random for a day.
Takes an item from the target's grasp, with no resisting roll.
A tonic that raises a physical trait, used within Cunning days.
A ray of harm at 50 feet after an hour wired to power.
The Storyteller rules the effect from the page.
An improvised bomb, stronger with more Rage.
A sting: the target resists with Stamina at 9 or takes lethal damage.
A whirlpool drags boats or bodies under.
An attack reaches Rank x 10 feet.
The Storyteller rules the effect from the page.
Crowds part and full speed is kept.
A concussion cone out to Stamina yards (double in water).
Devouring a foe in Minotaur form gives some of its strength.
Immune to eaten poison and taint.
Digs a trench a foot wide and deep and ten feet long per success.
Topples trees or foundations, more with successes.
A tainted spirit loses extra Essence.
Plants grow to maturity at a touch.
Cleanses a marked stretch of land over minutes or hours.
